faqs.question: What does the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal DNA sequences in a pure culture.

faqs.question: Why is the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture done?
faqs.answer: This test identifies specific fungal DNA sequences in a pure culture. Hence, this test is done • To diagnose fungal infections accurately: This test helps identify the specific type of fungus causing the infection, aiding in targeted treatment. • To guide appropriate antifungal therapy: The results help determine the most effective antifungal medication for treatment. • To monitor treatment response: Follow-up tests can help assess the effectiveness of antifungal therapy in treating the infection.

faqs.question: When is the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended when there is suspicion of a fungal infection. Patients who may require this test include those with • Suspected invasive fungal infections. • Persistent or recurrent fungal infections. • Immunocompromised conditions. • Inadequate response to previous antifungal treatment.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results indicate the presence of specific fungi associated with various infections.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture?
faqs.answer: A small sample from a pure culture will be collected. The sample will be sent to the laboratory for processing.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture?
faqs.answer: There are no specific preparations required for this test. However, it is essential to provide accurate clinical information and specimen details to assist in the accurate interpretation of results. Follow any additional instructions provided by your doctor or the laboratory. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside Panfungal-DNA detection include: • Fungal culture: To grow and identify the fungus causing the infection. • Antifungal susceptibility testing: To determine which antifungal medications are most effective against the identified fungus. • Histopathology: Examination of tissue samples to assess fungal invasion.

faqs.question: What is Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Pure Culture also known as?
faqs.answer: Panfungal Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and Sanger Sequencing test

faqs.question: What is a fungal infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal infection is a type of infection caused by certain types of fungi. It can affect various parts of the body, such as the skin, nails, respiratory tract, or internal organs, causing a range of symptoms.
